subject: QBR prep: sales snapshot, priority map, and consolidated forecast
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: sales snapshot, priority map, and consolidated forecast

Team —

QBR is two weeks out and the leadership readout wants a concise account-by-account view plus a single consolidated forecast we can publish internally. Goal is to have a one-page snapshot per top-10 accounts and a combined forecast roll-up by EOD Friday so I can fold into the exec deck on mon.

Asks: 
- Karthik: can you produce the consolidated forecast CSV (ARR by close month + confidence band) and a short note on key assumptions?
- Marcus: can you run the account health scores and flag accounts with procurement/contract blockers?
- Tessa: please assemble one-paragraph account snapshots for the top 10 (priority, next milestone, ask).

I’ve looped in Sarah for a quick procurement update on Acme — Sarah, if anything on your side changes the timing please flag it here so we can adjust the rollup.

Attachments: none yet — we’ll collect artifacts in the shared drive link below.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: sales snapshot, priority map, and consolidated forecast

Kimberly —

On Thu, Apr 8, 2027 at 09:02 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> QBR is two weeks out and the leadership readout wants a concise account-by-account view plus a single consolidated forecast we can publish internally. Goal is to have a one-page snapshot per top-10 accounts and a combined forecast roll-up by EOD Friday so I can fold into the exec deck on mon.

I’m pulling the forecast now. Preliminary notes:
- Consolidated view will include: weighted ARR by close month, current commit, and a conservative/likely/upside band.
- Assumptions: no new discounts beyond current redlines, no change to region routing that affects ACME timeline.
- Known timing risks: ACME procurement (pending contract) — marking as Medium until we hear back.

Quick Qs so I line items properly: 
1) For the roll-up do you want Net ARR or Gross ARR (including renewals that are contingent on new module purchases)? My default is Net ARR for QBR.
2) Should I include pipeline-stage counts for each account (e.g., demo/completed/contract/PO)? That’ll add 30–45m but helps explain confidence bands.

I’ll upload forecast-rollup-APR2027.csv to the drive by 3pm.

—Karthik
Director, Field Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: sales snapshot, priority map, and consolidated forecast

Kimberly / Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick procurement update from Acme:
- Legal has a final redline (data residency language) they want to resolve — internal LA and I are syncing with counsel on Friday. That’s the current blocker for our PO timing.
- If legal can close next week we should be able to issue a PO by 4/22; if not, timing slips into May.

Happy to do a 15-min check-in with your team next Tue (4/13) to run through the agreement and confirm milestones.

Best,
Sarah Blake
Head of Cloud Integrations
ACME Corp.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@acmecorp.com>, HubSpot HS-91234 <hubspot@records.redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: sales snapshot, priority map, and consolidated forecast

Thanks all — good progress. I’ve consolidated the artifacts and uploaded final stubs to the QBR folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR_April_2027

Attachments included here: forecast-rollup-APR2027.csv (Karthik’s consolidated forecast), account-snapshots-APR2027.xlsx (Tessa’s one-pagers), account-priority-map.png (Marcus’s health + blocker overlay). Please review the highlights below and confirm by EOD Friday so I can finalize the exec deck: 

Highlights / asks:
- Top-10 accounts: ACME, DeltaCloud, Fenwick Health, NovaRetail, SkyLabs — snapshots are in the spreadsheet. Confirm any factual errors directly in the doc.
- ACME: procurement flagged as Medium risk; Sarah offered a 4/13 15-min sync. Karthik — mark ACME as target close 2027-04 (best case) / 2027-05 (contingency).
- Forecast view: I chose Net ARR for the roll-up and included stage-level counts. If leadership prefers Gross ARR we can re-publish but it will change the midline by +$420k.
- Owner commitments:
  * Karthik: finalize and lock forecast assumptions (done in CSV)
  * Tessa: update snapshot for NovaRetail (pricing slide waiting)
  * Marcus: validate blocker status for Fenwick Health (legal/regulatory check)

Next steps: confirm changes in-line on the drive, and Marcus/Tessa/Karthik please confirm owners by EOD Fri. I’ll ship the exec-ready deck on Mon 4/12 morning.

Attachments (stubs):
- account-snapshots-APR2027.xlsx (one-pagers)
- forecast-rollup-APR2027.csv (weighted ARR + bands)
- account-priority-map.png (dashboard export)

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
